scope: Internal static inspection of no-fallback and synchronous unattached entry for the bounded protected-ownership program; no guest execution or attachment probes.

findings.claim: Rejected protected programs cannot fall back to ordinary execution
findings.basis: cbpf_jit_match dispatch precedes stock arm64 generation; rejection leaves jited false; unchanged bpf_prog_select_runtime requires JIT for a kfunc program and returns ENOTSUPP.

findings.claim: Typed TC/pinned retrieval and program-array insertion are denied
findings.basis: The cbpf_gate flag is rejected by bpf_prog_get_ok and bpf_prog_map_compatible.

findings.claim: Direct link creation and link replacement are denied
findings.basis: link_create checks cbpf_gate before dispatch and uses its existing out put path; link_update checks new_prog before old_prog acquisition and uses out_put_progs/out_put_link.

findings.claim: BTF-annotated trampoline targets are excluded from this backend
findings.basis: cbpf_jit_compile rejects func_info_cnt; stock bpf_check_attach_target requires matching target func_info.

findings.claim: Provider effects require the active synchronous test context
findings.basis: test_run holds local_bh_disable; cbpf_test_invoke installs private per-CPU state and rejects nesting; cbpf_enter verifies matching program cookie and first entry; ordinary registered kfunc bodies have no effects.

findings.claim: Runner connects the selected BPF calls to both observed native code views
findings.basis: Exact kernel/GET_INFO word equality, contiguous mapping, built-in BTF identity-to-operation mapping, expected A/B gate PCs/counters/tags, and entry/executive offsets are required.

limits: Source-level reasoning, not a formal refinement proof or runtime result.
No native ABI or platform interrupt-preservation certification follows from this review.
Provider root construction, trusted kernel/compiler, and the declared single synchronous program boundary remain assumptions.
Any later change to the hashed sources requires review of that delta.
